key_insight: The paper learns Koopman embeddings directly from data with a kernel-based autoencoder and bilevel optimization, avoiding the need to predefine the dictionary.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable, more interpretable alternative to ANN-based Koopman learning for forecasting and system identification in large computational datasets.
method: Use EDMD with a learned kernel dictionary instead of a fixed basis.
Optimize the dictionary and Koopman approximation jointly via bilevel optimization.
Leverage collocation so kernel matrix size depends on collocation points, not all training samples.
evidence_signal: Across numerical tests including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and video learning, EDMD-kDL matches or outperforms ANN-based methods.
watch_item: Performance and scalability still depend on the choice of collocation points and kernel design, which can affect training stability and solution quality.
paper_title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
